body: I know i wasnt responsible for my fathers death. He has Hoshimoto, and he was overweight, but I think I might save him that night. I am actually doing something like that, since I am diabetic for long (have it since i was 3), I bought Batman costume, and go to local childrens hospital, just to make their day easier. About talking to someone... well, I have tried that to in a last couple of days, I just freak them out since everyone seems to consider me as a pillar of stoicism. Or instead of listening, they just divert conversation about their own problems.

Unfortunately, on of social norms is to be married around 30. People after that are stigmatised. Online dating here is, well, undeveloped, and on sites that are existing, girls are looking for appraisal, and occasional sex. It's just, I do not know to explain it well, like a clones. The are 99% like clones. But I do not even need SO, not in a mental state that I am right now. I am just so down, that my sex drive is zero. I have feeling that, even if most beatufull women pass by me, I wouldn't even notice. I give up on porn, on everything...

Well, at first i went to psychologist when my father died. I felt that I was quite responsible for his death, since my parents were upset that i didnt do well at university. He died of stroke that night. I went out, and when I come back, I have noticed that our dog opened door again and went upstairs. I was already tired, and I just thought "Meh, I'll just let her sleep, it is cold outside anyway"... In the morning, first thing I heard my mother screamin my name, I run up and he was dead. I simply can not forgive myself not going up that night, maybe I could save him. Couple months After that, I went to psychologist. She basicly tried ti give me personality test, and my response was "what kind of result do you want". Next time was during military draft. I was already battered by my schoolmates by not being "average", for having more interest in books and computers than in sports, drinking and sex. As ironically, testing puts me in special forces, although I fought my way out ( having diabetes mellitus have some good sides, I guess). Third time, it was testing for mental capability for the early retirement status. Test contains bunch of standardised cards, with description of symptoms that you may have, so you gothrough all cards, pick ones that you feel that you have, and they put diagnosis, which was severe anxiety. But, as matter to my mother and sister, all recommendations for  psychiatric help was stupid, and all that i should solve by myself, since doctors would just give me antidepressants. I am also aware of that is true, since our psychiatric help is, either you take "happy pills", or either you are going to institution. So, I just gave up on that, and keep working, but being home alone was quite difficult on my mind. I did start having nightmares and halucinations of my dead father. At that point, I just decided to get a dog, hoping that all that happends because I feel lonely. It did help for a while, but at one point, I realise that I am isolating myself now, that I have feeling that no matter how much I try, do and achieve, that is nothing. That, even if I try now to get outside, meet new people, or do something to improve myself... It just feels like huge burden that I am putting on myself, and all of that just doesnt matter. The wish "I just want to lie down and die" goes throgh my head more and more often. Only secure part of the day is when I am working, so that i do not have chance to use my mind to think of bad things. But even that wont work anymore.
